scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000

scripts.speaker: Kachua
scripts.text:
Diamonds...!
I simply can't get my mind off
them! Ever since that man
showed me that diamond,
it's been all I think about!
Would you like to have mine?
Ah, what a shame...

scripts.speaker: Kachua
scripts.text:
Yes, I know...
Even among everything
in my collections, nothing
compares to diamonds...

scripts.speaker: Kachua
scripts.text:
*piff*
You don't have any diamonds!
Don't even try to fool me!

scripts.speaker: Kachua
scripts.text:
Are you sure you don't mind
giving this to me? Thank you
so much! I don't have much in
the way of money, but i can give
you something from one of my
collections~

scripts.speaker: Kachua
scripts.text:
Errr...
You brought too many things.
You can't receive this item now.
You better reorganize your inventory and try again.

scripts.speaker: Kachua
scripts.text:
So what would
you like to have?
Weapon
Armor
Garment
Helmet
Shoes
Shield

scripts.speaker: Kachua
scripts.text:
Ah~ that Diamond is so beautiful.
I wish I could repay you better.

scripts.speaker: Devellin
scripts.text:
It seems some traveller showed
a huge diamond to Kachua a while ago. Ever since then, all she's been talking about is diamonds and how much she wants them.

scripts.speaker: Devellin
scripts.text: She's been getting pretty obsessive about it, which scares me. It seems she's more than willing to sacrifice anything she owns for a diamond.

scripts.speaker: Devellin
scripts.text: She's the type of person who'll do anything to get what she wants. I'm worried that she might give away something far more valuable than a diamond in exchange...

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
Heeeey...
It seems we share the same line of work, you and me. Heh heh, lemme give you a hot tip.

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text: I've been charging other people for this information, but since, shall we say, we work in the same professional field, I don't have the heart to take your zeny.

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
You see that lady over there?
She's just totally in love with diamonds. And from what my sources tell me, she's loaded. Tons and tons of valuables.

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
I'm talkin' rare items.
I took the liberty of sneaking a peek at what she owns, and saw she's got a helmet with goat horns and even a crown! She's so rich it's ridiculous!

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text: The buzz that's been going around is that she's got a cache of rare equipment and weapons too! So whaddya say? Wanna be partners in crime and rob her house?
No, thanks.
Sweet, I'm in!

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
Wha...?
C'mon! I thought pilfering was something you do! Aw well, I'm gonna do it, but stay hushed on this, got it?

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
Ha ha ha!
...^660000Dork^000000!
I'm just jivin'
sp fuggedabout it!

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text: Ah right. Supposedly, there's a mountain where tons of diamonds are buried. A pal o' mine says there's a mine near the mountain too, so I guess if you went to the mine, you'd find Diamonds.

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text: I guess it can't hurt to gather some Diamonds there and try to exchange them for whatever the old lady's got. Take care, pal~

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
Hey...
I got a hot tip for you.
It'll just cost you 500 zeny
and trust me, it's worth it.
So whaddya say...?
Alright.
No, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text: You see that lady over there? She's just totally in love with diamonds. And from what my sources tell me, she's loaded. Tons and tons of valuables.

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
I'm talkin' rare items.
I took the liberty of sneaking a peek at what she owns, and saw she's got a helmet with goat horns and even a crown! She's so rich it's ridiculous!

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text: There's a chance that rare equipment and weapons might be yours! She'll give anything for a 3 carat diamond. So if you have any of those, you might as well see her.

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
Ah right. Supposedly, there's a mountain where tons of diamonds
are buried. A pal o' mine says there's a mine near the mountain too, so I guess if you went to the mine, you'd find Diamonds.

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text: I guess it can't hurt to gather some Diamonds there and try to exchange them for whatever the old lady's got. Take care, pal~

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
What the hell?!
Don't you have any money? Didn't I say 500 zeny? Hey man, info like this doesn't come cheap!

scripts.speaker: Cain
scripts.text:
Hey hey!
What are you, a cheapskate? You understand that everything has its price and this information is so worth it. C'mon, you can't pass this up, can you?
^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
Wahahahaha~
I've dug up a fortune!

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
Diamonds! Hundreds and
thousands of Diamonds,
all of them mine!
I'm rich!
I want to buy some.
Congratulations.

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
Ah, you have an
eye for valuables!
Sure, sure why not!
I'll give you a discount, too!
55,000 Zeny for a diamond,
how does that sound?

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
How many
diamonds do you need?
If you change your mind,
please enter '0' to cancel.

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
Alright, you've
canceled the trade.
Take care!

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
The maximum
amount is 500.
Please enter 500 or less.

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
Errr...
I'm sorry, but you
do not have enough money.
I'll be losing money if
I sell them at that price.

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
Errr...
You're carrying too many items.
I don't think give you anything if there's no room in your inventory. Why don't you put some of your stuff into Kafra Storage?

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
Thank you for
buying my diamonds!
You're welcome to
come back anytime.

scripts.speaker: Dwayne
scripts.text:
Haha, thank you~
If by any chance
you need a diamond,
please drop by.
I'll sell them to
you at a cheap price.
